description_text: Proposed procurement for NSN 5330006028371 GASKET,COMPRESSOR: Line 0001 Qty 411 UI EA Deliver To: By: 0061 DAYS ADO This Solicitation may result in an Automated IDC (Indefinite Delivery Contract).
